info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Offers Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Offers Retrieval API enables users to fetch specific loan offer details associated with a loan application. By providing a unique loan application ID and the corresponding offer ID, consumers can access comprehensive information about available offers for a given application. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and service providers who need to present tailored loan options to customers. Typical use cases include displaying loan offers in customer portals or integrating with financial advisory tools.

get.summary: Retrieve loan offers for a specific loan application.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all loan offers associated with a specified loan application identified by its unique ID. Use this to gather potential financing options available to the applicant.

requestBody.description: Retrieve the loan offers related to the specific loan application identified by RES-100045. The request body should contain any necessary parameters specified by the API schema.

GetLoanOffersByApplicationIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving offers related to loan applications.
